description: This file defines a React component for the main page of a personal notes manager application, handling user authentication, fetching, creating, saving, and deleting notes, and rendering the UI components.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Main React component for the notes application page, managing state and user interactions.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API and updates state.

methods.name: handleCreateNote
methods.description: Creates a new note via API and refreshes notes list.

methods.name: handleSaveNote
methods.description: Saves changes to the current note via API.

methods.name: handleDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note via API and updates state.
